examples.text: The stupid rusty wire cut my thumb when I grabbed it.

examples.text: No sigh to rise, no tear had pow'r to flow, Fix'd in a stupid lethargy of woe.

examples.text: Were it not for [fire], the whole wou'd be one great stupid inanimate mass.

glosses: Dulled in feeling or sensation; torpid.

glosses: The condition or state of being stupid; stupidity, stupidness.

examples.text: His stupid knows no bounds.

glosses: Lacking sense or meaning, often to the point of boredom or annoyance.

examples.text: Francesca followed, reluctant enough in her secret; for though she would not have admitted it even to herself, she did shrink from the infliction of the inane solemnities with which her father garnished his discourse—to say nothing of the ungracious reflections which so often glanced at herself.

examples.text: The undistinguishable inane of infinite space.

glosses: Lacking the ability to cut easily; not sharp.
